claims.claim: The candidate contains one v1 reviewer procedure registry with one reviewer-semantic-v1 profile, the specified metadata and bounds, and the required ordered PRIMARY and DELTA steps. The registry supplies the procedure prose.

The registry states the required PRIMARY and DELTA review checks, distinguishes semantic BLOCKED from protocol, material, and transport failures, and requires one Reviewer invocation without voting or hidden session inputs.

The pure parser and selector enforce the closed v1 structure and bounds, select only PRIMARY or DELTA, and digest the normalized complete profile and bounds. The repaired fixture derives LF and CRLF inputs from the same canonical LF bytes; its targeted test passed.
The production module operates on caller-supplied material and contains no filesystem, Git, network, provider, REVIEW lifecycle, or persistent-state operations.
